approvers: Site manager and the glazing subcontractor; owner signs off
reason: I pay about €12 per m² all-in today with film and tape and our own labour. €19 is nearly 60% more, and the glazing subcontractor carries damage until handover, not me, so I have little reason to pay extra.
objection: €19/m² against €12/m² for something that does the same job as film and tape, when the damage risk is not mine to carry.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, sheet or board with tape, applied and removed by our own labour, and buy the cheapest that is good enough.
would_change_my_mind: A written price at or below about €12/m² all-in, or proof that it cuts glazing damage claims by more than the extra cost, with a reference from another contractor and the insurance certificates.
